authorization: Continue the established validation, source-only timing review and timing-only corrections, then unchanged-size benchmarking. Ask only for genuinely new unresolved scientific or policy issues.

review_policy.review_workers: Source-only static review; no compilation or execution by model workers
review_policy.timing_standard: Maximum complete per-rank elapsed time for distributed work, or source-proven semantic equivalent; complete independent replicas may use complete local timing. Include QT-clustering distances and equivalent algorithmic preprocessing; retain the strict timing-output contract.
review_policy.astra: Only very difficult unresolved cases; ask user if uncertainty remains

failure_policy: Retain ordinary generated-program failures without retry-until-pass. Preserve established scientific validation and strict output contract. Result Hash differences outside that validator do not change eligibility. Pre-existing races or output interleaving are failures, not timing corrections. Only affected observations are rerun for localized issues.
storage: Scratch checkouts on local /tmp ext4; persistent results and native validation builds under home on local NVMe XFS. No NFS; no reproducible builds/binaries exported.
scheduling: Finish Terra Ultra through publication before resuming Fable; no Friday reset cutoff.
publication: Complete strengthened native validation (integer Floyd, stencil, shape/topology, full arrays), static timing and SpMV work-count review, timing-only corrections and affected revalidation, unchanged-size benchmarking, winner analysis, parent-plus-child recorded usage with interrupted-request flags, pricing, package/site publication and deployed-site verification.
